bio: Set in tranquil surroundings in the heart of the Lake District, Macdonald Leeming House provides an oasis of calm that is perfect to relax and indulge in the great British tradition of Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea can be served in either the Lake View Lounge which is a warm and relaxing room featuring an open fire or the outdoor terrace where guests can enjoy panoramic views of Lake Ullswater and Hallin Fell.  Their Afternoon Tea menu consists of an array of sweet and savoury items such as finger sandwiches & warm scones with jam. If you are feeling extra indulgent then you can upgrade to include a glass of Champagne.  Junction Beckenham is in Watermillock, just a short drive away from Penrith, Cumbria.
